name: Klaberjass
description: Klaberjass (also known as Clob, Bella, or Bela) is a quintessential two-player trick-taking game that has enjoyed immense popularity for over a century. Known for its complex ranking of trumps (where the Jack and Nine are the most powerful) and the 'Bella' bonus (King and Queen of trumps), it is a game of skill, nerve, and precise point-counting. It belongs to the Jass family of games.

content.text: Klaberjass (also known as Clob, Bella, or Bela) is a quintessential two-player trick-taking game that has enjoyed immense popularity for over a century. Known for its complex ranking of trumps (where the Jack and Nine are the most powerful) and the 'Bella' bonus (King and Queen of trumps), it is a game of skill, nerve, and precise point-counting. It belongs to the Jass family of games.
Rooted in the Low Countries (Netherlands/Belgium) and popularized by Jewish communities in Central Europe. The name likely stems from 'Klaverjas' (Dutch for Jack of Clubs).
Two players. The game is played head-to-head; each player receives six cards initially, then after trump is determined each receives three more for a total of nine cards per hand.
Each player is dealt 6 cards (3 then 3). One card is turned up to start trump determination. After trump is set, another 3 cards are dealt to each player (total 9 per hand).

items.text: Clob: Popular American English name for the game.
Kalooki-style Klab: A variant with Joker wildcards.
